text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Whew...
We finally put those copycows in the dirt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は～
なんとかオラたちに似たやつは倒せたべ。

text_block_list.name: Hanzo
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? I'm almost impressed.
But this isn't even my final mode. Wait until you see my true power.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほぅ……
なかなかやるな。
ここまでの相手となるといい加減、
本気を出さねばならぬか。

text_block_list.name: Inspector
text_block_list.text:
What?! You! You've purposely been holding back?!
Get it together, man! Don't forget the fortune I'm paying you!
Remove every single trace of these peasants at once!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ！？　
貴様！　
今まで手を抜いていたというのか！
ふざけるな！　
私が払っている高い金を忘れるな！
とっととやつらを
跡形もなく消してしまえ！

text_block_list.name: Hanzo
text_block_list.text: I don't have to be told.

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: Is it just me, or can you sense some internal discord?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか
あちらさん
仲間割れしてない？

text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: I don't think they were ever friends. But still, you're right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もともと仲間って感じもしないけど、
確かにそうだね。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text: Let's show them how strong we are when we fight as a team!
text_block_list.orig_text:
力を合わせて戦う強さ、
見せつけてやりましょう！

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
You got it!
When we pull together, ain't nobody got a cowbell's chance in hell!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だべな！
オラたちが揃えば、
向かうところ敵なしだべ！
